note: Executed adversarial corpus for injection-resistance-gate against the apikeys-vault secrets store. The target (node injection-driver.mjs <input>) drives the REAL core.mjs and asserts this domain's security invariants on EVERY run: raw-key-never-leaks, cross-tenant isolation under hostile tenantIds, no prototype-pollution via load(), no env-secret leak. Each case varies the hostile input; the driver exits 0 (PROBE_OK) only if all invariants hold, 1 on any breach. Refuted against a deliberately-leaky core (caught, exit 1) on 2026-07-04.
